import itertools
import json

def recovered(x):
    a = x[0] and x[5]
    b = x[6] and x[9]
    c = x[6] or x[8]
    d = x[2] and x[5]
    e = x[3] or x[9]
    f = not (x[5] and x[7])
    g = x[5] and x[6]

    p = not (a and b)
    q = not (a or c)
    r = not (d or e)
    s = f or g

    return (p != q) if x[9] else (r or s)
